## 1) Test records

a) Start the test procedure documented in your technical guidance notes, or follow your employer's instructions.

b) Where an appliance fails, record the result to the nearest hundredth in the field provided. E.g. 25.00

c) If a fail condition occurs before any tests can be carried out, record the result as N/A in the appropriate fields.

   > E.g. The cable is sheared: record **N/A** in all fields in the test procedure.

d) If tests are being carried out on a unit which is disconnected but still within reach, such as a hooven iron, with the plug isolated but still attached, it may be possible to, using test leads, carry out the tests from the live socket.
